meta.heading: Round 11: a notepad under each item, bring it up tomorrow, and tickets that aren't done
meta.intro: Your three questions as proposals. Step 2 of the Canvas (project areas, links, timeline) is being built meanwhile.

r11-asks.title: Three things you asked for
body: **A notepad under each ticket or entry.** Every entry already has a Notes field, but it's hidden in the details panel. Proposal: a small **Notes** fold under each entry and each Done ticket, on the Desk cards and on Day. Click it and a notepad opens right there, saved as you type. A Done ticket's notepad grows from "a few words" to a full note.

**Bring up tomorrow.** There is a "Tomorrow I start with…" list, but only inside the end-of-day wrap-up, and that's off unless you turn it on in Settings → Your day. So you probably never saw it. Proposal: **Bring up tomorrow** in the right-click menu of every card and row. It goes on tomorrow's list, and tomorrow "Where was I?" shows it first when you open Shiftbook. No wrap-up needed.

**A ticket you worked on but haven't finished.** The tray says "Done", which is wrong for those. Proposal: rename it **Tickets** and give each one a tick, on by default. Untick it and it's **Still open**: its time still counts today, it gets an open ring, and it comes back in tomorrow's tray until you tick it.

questions.legend: Notepad under each entry and ticket

options.value: Also a button on each card
Rename to Tickets, with a done tick
Keep Done tickets, add a separate "Working on" list

questions.placeholder: e.g. open tickets should also show on the Desk until done

r11-asks.pick: All three as described. They're small, and I'll build them right after step 2.
